messages.subject: Re: MplusAutomation (extractTech10 function)
parts:
Hi Mariusz,

You are generally better off emailing the MplusAutomation group (cced here) for discussion, as other users see your question (and answer), plus both Michael and I monitor that list so you have a higher chance of a response.


The error you get is a red herring because you are calling a function that is not exported from the MplusAutomation package.  Generally, you readModels() to read in output files, which parses every portion of the file that we have functions to parse, rather than using functions to extract specific sections.

But the real issue is that as far as I know, although there is a skeleton function for extracting Tech10, that feature is not yet implemented in MplusAutomation.  

If you or others were interested in working on implementing it, I'd be happy to mentor, but as none my "official" work generally uses mixture models, at the moment I do not have time to work on writing a parser for Tech10.  Michael may know more or have some idea if it is on his to-do list.  

If you don't need all the information, it may be fairly simple to write something that reads in just one piece (e.g., total pearson chi-square from empty cells, or something like that).

Sorry its not better news!

Josh
